Captures healthy pre-restart service/data and boot ID d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 59a056ba-f4d6-4e96-9e1a-4836982d3388, system readiness, and recovered application, listener, SELinux enforcement, and firewall state.
